shots.name: desktop-orientacao
steps: localStorage.removeItem('ax-fio-nobre-demo'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); const refazer = [...document.querySelectorAll('#questionario button')].find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Refazer')); if (refazer) { refazer.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const responder = async (i) => { [...document.querySelectorAll('#questionario fieldset button')][i].click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); }; await responder(2); await responder(0); await responder(3); await responder(0); await responder(1); await responder(2);
